response.sql: WITH employee_groups AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) as employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), totals AS (SELECT SUM(employee_count) as total_employees, COUNT(*) as num_groups FROM employee_groups) SELECT eg.ReportsTo, eg.employee_count, eg.employee_count * 1.0 / t.total_employees as share, eg.employee_count * 1.0 / t.total_employees - 1.0 / t.num_groups as difference_from_average FROM employee_groups eg CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC LIMIT 10
